verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of a pause/resume mechanism for human approval mid-run — no mention of human_input flags, interrupt/resume APIs, or approval gates. A competitor even claims CrewAI 'lacks persistent state and deterministic hooks' that would enable this kind of interaction (crewai-comm-4), but this isn't framed as contradicting a vendor claim since none is present in the pack. This is a fair axis for an agent orchestration framework, so absence of evidence yields 'none' rather than 'na'.
